About.heroDesc: From Cho Gao's fertile dragon fruit plantations, Hung Thinh Phat develops a transparent, clean agriculture supply chain aimed at international markets.
letterParagraphs: Tien Giang has long been renowned as an alluvial and fertile province, the heartland of sweet red and white dragon fruits and thriving tropical produce. Born and raised on this soil, we witnessed firsthand the tireless devotion of our farmers and recognized the boundless potential of Vietnamese agriculture across international markets.

However, traditional barriers in farming standards, post-harvest preservation, and brand transparency previously exposed local growers to market instability. Bound by the vision of a clean, ethical, and self-reliant agriculture, Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative was founded.
We partner directly with farmers from soil preparation, VietGAP/GLOBALG.A.P. agronomic training, to investing in modern HACCP-certified post-harvest sorting and packing facilities.
About.visionDesc: Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative aims to become a leading enterprise in raw material development, technology transfer, post-harvest processing, circular agriculture, and agricultural distribution across Vietnam and globally.
About.missionDesc: Walking hand in hand with Farmers, Consumers, Workers, Society, Agriculture, Environment, and the Nation.
missions: Educate and guide farmers in adopting modern safe cultivation techniques.
Serve as a dependable partner assisting growers in agronomy, compliance, and guaranteed off-take.
Build connected supply chains spanning farming inputs, harvest operations, and distribution channels.
Foster sustainable, high-value modern agriculture for the community.
Protect soil, water, and air ecosystems through biological and safe cultivation practices.
Build pride and prestige for regional and national agricultural produce.
About.valuesDesc: Three core values shape how Hung Thinh Phat nurtures every fruit, cares for consumers, and supports the local farming community.
About.journeyDesc: Every milestone marks our progress in standardizing orchards, upgrading post-harvest capacity, and expanding international export markets.

milestones.title: March 2021: Founded on Determination to Innovate
milestones.text: Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative was officially incorporated under Business License 1201647060, establishing strict standardized processes from day one.

milestones.title: Facility Standardization & Food Safety Certification
items: Awarded Food Safety Eligibility Certificate No. 052/2022/NNPTNT-TG by Tien Giang DARD on 19/04/2022.
Achieved HACCP Codex 2020 Food Safety Management System certification for post-harvest sorting and packing.

milestones.title: Breakthrough in Official Fresh Exports
items: Established sustainable orchard registration codes and expanded packing facility operations.
Successfully exported fresh dragon fruits through official channels to the US and Middle East, achieving 203 billion VND in revenue.

milestones.title: Expansion of GLOBALG.A.P. Raw Material Supply
items: Expanded our affiliated cultivation network to nearly 115 ha under GLOBALG.A.P. and VietGAP standards.
Diversified export fresh portfolio: Red, white, and yellow dragon fruits, fresh coconuts, seedless watermelons, and mangoes.

milestones.title: Strengthening Partnerships & Deep Processing
milestones.text: Expanded export partnerships and offered tailored OEM post-harvest sorting and packaging services for domestic and overseas brands.

milestones.title: Towards a Comprehensive End-to-End Value Chain
items: Broaden domestic trade and export distribution networks.
Invest in raw material sustainability and closed-loop agro-forestry models.
Install cold storage and deep freezing equipment for post-harvest value addition.
Train personnel and elevate management and traceability systems.
Lead farmer communication toward eco-friendly, circular farming methodologies.

ProcessContact.processDesc: Ensuring dragon fruits retain their crisp sweetness, vibrant red peel, and firm green bracts upon arrival at global destinations.
ProcessContact.processSubDesc: At Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative, the entire flow strictly complies with the HACCP Codex 2020 Food Safety Management System.
ProcessContact.stepsDesc: Operated with precise hygiene and grading controls to guarantee post-harvest freshness, safety, and full batch traceability.

steps.title: Raw Material Receiving & Initial Sorting
steps.text: Dragon fruits from affiliated GLOBALG.A.P. orchards in Cho Gao, Tien Giang are harvested at peak ripeness and transported to the facility promptly.
bullets: Record harvest date, orchard code, and tonnage
QC culls fruits not meeting export standards

steps.title: Surface Cleaning with Pressurized Water System
steps.text: Fruits enter automated washing lines using technical-grade clean water. Calibrated spray nozzles remove farm dust and debris without bruising delicate peel.

steps.title: Air Drying & Quality Treatment
steps.text: Following washing, fruits travel on air-drying conveyors to remove moisture from stems and bract crevices, preventing mold during packing and transport.

steps.title: Weight Grading & Traceability Labeling
steps.text: Trained workers weigh and grade fruits to contract specifications. Each fruit is sleeved in foam netting or specialized export PE bags.
bullets: Weighed and sorted to purchase order tiers

steps.title: Carton Packing & 2-Tier Quality Control
steps.text: Dragon fruits are carefully packed in moisture-resistant export cartons. Standard configurations include 6 kg, 9 kg, or 15 kg boxes.
bullets: Check freshness, seals, and export markings
steps.alt: Carton packing and quality inspection area

steps.title: Pre-cooling & Export Cold Storage
steps.text: Packed cartons enter pre-cooling chambers to reduce core temperature, followed by cold storage maintaining steady relative humidity.
bullets: Extends shelf-life for 30–35 days in transit
Reefer containers inspected prior to loading

LongGiaNhaToi.heroSubtitle: Adopt a Dragon Fruit Pillar, Follow the Whole Journey
LongGiaNhaToi.heroDesc: Long Gia Home Orchard is a digital adoption experience created by Hung Thinh Phat Clean Agriculture Cooperative. Follow the growth of your dragon fruit tree directly on the website.
LongGiaNhaToi.diaryDesc: Every care routine is transparently logged, making it effortless to accompany your dragon fruit pillar through each stage of development.

stages.title: Off-Season LED Lighting
stages.short: Stimulates uniform flowering across scheduled growth cycles.
stages.detail: Specialized agricultural LED arrays illuminate orchards nightly from 22:00 to 02:00 to stimulate uniform floral induction. Agronomists monitor light intensity and soil moisture to achieve optimal flowering rates.

stages.title: Canopy Pruning
stages.short: Prunes older branches to concentrate nutrition into vigorous shoots.
stages.detail: Older, shaded, or diseased branches are carefully pruned away to direct plant nutrition toward healthy flowering shoots. All treatments utilize organic bio-fertilizers adhering to VietGAP/GLOBALG.A.P. guidelines.

stages.title: Fruit Bagging
stages.short: Shields developing young fruits during critical growth periods.
stages.detail: As young fruits develop, each fruit is carefully covered in breathable protective bags. This natural barrier prevents pest attacks without relying on synthetic chemical pesticides.

stages.title: Harvest & Sorting
stages.short: Hand-picked at ideal ripeness, packed, and delivered to adopters.
stages.detail: Fruits reaching optimal ripeness, crisp green bracts, and juicy sweetness are harvested at dawn. They undergo sorting, gentle sanitization, and packaging under strict food safety protocols before doorstep delivery.
